name: Henry G. Sherwood
role: High councilor, Nauvoo marshal, and Nauvoo House stockholder
dateNote: Section 124 named him in January 1841 as a Nauvoo House stockholder and high councilor.
importance: Section 124 invites him to pay stock into the Nauvoo House for himself and his descendants. It also confirms him on the Nauvoo high council, where he had served since 1839. He was Nauvoo city marshal from 1841 to 1843. He crossed to the Salt Lake Valley in 1847 but later became disaffected and died in San Bernardino.
connections: He was ordained an elder by Jared and Simeon Carter. He served on the high council with Newel Knight, Samuel Bent, and others named in section 124.

sources.title: Henry Garlick Sherwood, Joseph Smith Papers

reviewNote: Birth (20 April 1785, New York), ordination, high councils, marshal, 1847 pioneer company, and 1856 disaffection checked on JSP. Death date 24 November 1867 appears only in a citation fragment.
